parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH INPUT VOLTAGE RATING DROP: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 is rated to only 24 V rec. (38 V abs max, p.4) vs TPS70933DBVR at 30 V rec. (32 V abs max, p.4). Verify worst-case input transient spikes.
CAUTION DROPOUT HEADROOM: Typical dropout differs (AP2204K-3.3TRG1: 360 mV p.5 vs TPS70933DBVR: 960 mV p.5); verify Vin,min - Vout >= Vdo across temperature and load corners.

HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: TPS70933DBVR has a lower Vin,abs,max rating (32 V, p.4) than AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (38 V, p.4); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 32 V.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP2204K-3.3TRG1: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C TA; -40°C to +125°C TJ) vs TPS70933DBVR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ; EC tested -40°C to +85°C TA)); AP2204K-3.3TRG1 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
CAUTION LIFECYCLE STATUS (NRND): AP2204K-3.3TRG1 is flagged NRND by Diodes Incorporated; do not design into new production layouts — evaluate Active alternatives.
engineering_verdict: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and TPS70933DBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because Vin,max rating drops >=20%; dropout voltage headroom differs (600 mV / 2.7x); Vin,abs,max drops >=15% (32 V vs 38 V). Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 63.8 °C on AP2204K-3.3TRG1 (θJA 250 °C/W) vs 54.1 °C on TPS70933DBVR (θJA 212.1 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 15.4x ratio (20 µA (p.5) vs 1.3 µA (p.5)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2204K-3.3TRG1 "Severe 24 V High-Voltage Thermal Derating in SOT-23-5 (θJA = 250 °C/W Limits Load < 20 mA)" (p.4) and TPS70933DBVR "CRITICAL EN Pin Destruction Trap — 6.5 V Zener Clamp & 7 V Abs Max" (p.4). BOM decision: Choose AP2204K-3.3TRG1 when low Vin-Vout headroom requires 360 mV dropout; choose TPS70933DBVR when battery sleep budget demands 1.3 µA Iq or input rails climb above 24 V (rated to 30 V). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
